title: rhamnus saxatilis var. humifusa
intro: Rhamnus saxatilis var. humifusa, commonly known as Alpine buckthorn or creeping buckthorn, is a plant species in the Rhamnaceae family. It is a type of shrub native to Europe and western Asia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help protect against cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus saxatilis var. humifusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
